name: YOOAdmin
author: Rami Obeidat

sections.description:
YOOAdmin improves the default WordPress admin experience with a cleaner interface, smarter organization, and productivity-focused tools.

Designed around real-world agency, freelancer, and business workflows, YOOAdmin helps you work faster inside wp-admin without modifying WordPress core files.

Instead of replacing WordPress, YOOAdmin modernizes and reorganizes the admin experience while preserving native familiarity and compatibility.

Whether you manage one website or many, YOOAdmin creates a calmer, more organized, and more professional workspace.

Core Features

  • Modern and clean admin workspace experience
  • Studio Hub admin theme with a customizable card-based workspace home
  • Light, dark, and system appearance modes
  • Admin theme settings for colors and appearance
  • Workspace notes and activity overview widgets (Studio Hub)
  • Converts distracting admin notices into a centralized notification center
  • Focus Mode for distraction-free work
  • Workspace dashboard customization tools
  • Branding tools (logo, title, colors)
  • Modern login page customization
  • Live login page preview
  • Custom login logo and side image
  • Improved Posts, Pages, Categories, and Tags views
  • Enhanced Users pages and profiles
  • Better admin menu organization
  • Theme and color customization
  • Translation ready with WordPress.org language support
  • Optional full data cleanup tool
  • Multisite compatible
  • No frontend impact
  • Fully reversible using WordPress hooks

Studio Hub

Studio Hub introduces a calmer, workspace-focused WordPress experience inspired by modern productivity applications.

It provides a cleaner dashboard home, customizable workspace sections, activity widgets, workspace notes, and a more focused workflow inside wp-admin.

Notification Center

YOOAdmin converts distracting plugin notices and admin banners into a cleaner and more organized notification center experience.

Important messages stay accessible while your workspace remains focused and uncluttered.

Focus Mode

Reduce clutter and stay productive.

Focus Mode simplifies the admin area by minimizing distractions and improving clarity while you work.

Login Page Customizer

Create a modern branded WordPress login page with live preview, custom logos, side images, and clean layout options.

Improve the login experience for yourself, your team, or your clients.

Branding & Customization

Make WordPress feel like your own workspace:

  • Upload custom logo
  • Change colors
  • Customize workspace appearance
  • Improve client-facing admin experience

Optional Account Connection

YOOAdmin works fully without creating or connecting any external account.

You may optionally connect your website to a YOOAdmin account for account linking and status verification only.

Connecting an account does not disable or unlock core plugin features.

Privacy

If account connection is used, the plugin may communicate with yooadmin.io for verification purposes.

This may include:

  • Website URL
  • Server IP address

No personal data, visitor data, analytics, or user tracking data is collected.

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect personal data by default.

If account connection is used, website URL and server IP may be used only for verification.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/yooadmin, or install through Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. After activation, the setup wizard opens automatically.
  4. Complete the quick setup steps.
  5. Start using your new workspace.
sections.faq:
Is YOOAdmin free?

Yes. All core features included in this version are free.

Do I need to connect an account?

No. The plugin works fully without any connection.

Does it modify WordPress core files?

No. YOOAdmin uses standard WordPress hooks and can be removed cleanly.

Does it slow down my website?

No. It runs only inside the admin workspace and does not affect the frontend.

Can I use it on client websites?

Yes.

Does it support multisite?

Yes.

Is YOOAdmin translation ready?

Yes. YOOAdmin follows WordPress localization standards and supports community translations through WordPress.org.

Is my data tracked?

No user tracking or analytics data is collected.

Does YOOAdmin leave data behind after removal?

No. YOOAdmin includes an optional cleanup tool that can safely remove plugin settings, notifications, and custom tables.
sections.changelog:
1.5.5

  • New: Adaptive dark mode engine for third-party plugin admin screens, including React, Tailwind-style, WordPress Components, classic PHP settings pages, and portaled modals
  • New: Expanded dark mode support for native WordPress dashboard widgets, embedded WooCommerce setup, Yoast SEO dashboards, plugin modals, onboarding panels, progress indicators, and floating notices
  • New: Dashboard Redirect setting to switch the Home action between the YOOAdmin dashboard and the classic WordPress dashboard
  • New: Yoast SEO and readability score indicators on YOOAdmin Posts and Pages list screens, with support for Yoast indexable data
  • Improved: Studio Hub dark mode now relies on broader surface, typography, button, table, form, stepper, and notification rules instead of plugin-specific overrides
  • Improved: Dashboard widget styling for modern and legacy plugin interfaces, including nested light panels, utility-class colors, disabled actions, and setup wizards
  • Improved: Posts and Pages list layouts — compact status badges on featured images, restored page role badges, and clearer badge placement in card and table views
  • Improved: Plugin Install Basic — matched search field height with filter selectors, clearer plugin card structure, corrected pagination spacing, and a refined upload form with YOOAdmin button styling
  • Improved: Notification center — banner-to-notification conversion with clearer message extraction, accurate plugin source labels, and a reliable delete action from the notification modal
  • Improved: Adaptive dark mode engine refactored for easier maintenance and fewer redundant compatibility rules
  • Fixed: Dark mode readability on Jetpack, Yoast SEO, WooCommerce embedded screens, Wordfence banners, TinyMCE settings, WPBakery, and similar third-party admin pages
  • Fixed: Light backgrounds, low-contrast text, incorrect secondary buttons, unread indicators, progress bars, and modal surfaces appearing incorrectly in dark mode
  • Fixed: Notification modal delete action, converted notice content, sender attribution, and dark mode contrast for message text and action links
  • Fixed: Classic WordPress widget panel in dashboard edit mode — unavailable-widgets notice and link no longer hidden when banner conversion is enabled
  • Fixed: YOOAdmin Settings Save Changes button text color in dark mode
  • Fixed: Admin search clear button size, placement, and orange styling on Plugin Install and related screens
  • Fixed: Restore consistent orange styling for the breadcrumbs Home icon in dark mode
  • Fixed: Classic WordPress dashboard dark mode when Dashboard Redirect is disabled

1.5.4

  • New: Plugin Install Basic layout for plugin-install.php (site and network admin), matches Pages/Posts/Plugins design, gated by Focus Mode and a new settings toggle
  • New: Plugin Install Basic option in Settings, General, System & Users, and in the setup wizard
  • New: Block editor (Gutenberg) dark mode for post create and edit screens
  • Improved: Block editor dark mode, unified header, sidebar, toolbar, popovers, and editor canvas styling
  • Improved: Block editor layout, full-bleed admin chrome without extra padding
  • Improved: Classic editor (TinyMCE) dark mode, toolbar, writing area, and editor tabs
  • Improved: WPBakery Page Builder backend editor dark mode, controls, composer switch, and settings screens
  • Improved: Plugin admin settings dark mode, cleaner form tables without double background stripes
  • Improved: Plugin install page, filter chips, hero search, plugin cards, pagination, and dark mode styling
  • Improved: Plugin install upload tab, upload form inside the hero with tighter spacing
  • Improved: Plugins page layout, filter chips, table shell, active rows, checkboxes, column dividers, and pagination
  • Improved: Pages and Posts list views, dark mode tables, filter chips, and grid placeholder images
  • Improved: Setup wizard, terms acceptance no longer required to continue
  • Fixed: Block editor white panels, toolbars, and sidebars in dark mode
  • Fixed: Dark gaps and mismatched backgrounds around the block editor
  • Fixed: TinyMCE toolbar and writing area staying light in dark mode, fix included in YOOAdmin
  • Fixed: WPBakery backend controls, invisible row icons and unreadable composer/Gutenberg buttons, fix included in YOOAdmin
  • Fixed: Faded Add New buttons and filter tabs on Pages, Posts, and Plugins
  • Fixed: Plugins page tabs disappearing after WordPress bulk-action form change
  • Fixed: Plugin install card layout, titles and descriptions stacking one character per line
  • Fixed: Plugins page dark mode, white table header/footer, active rows, and missing column separators
  • Fixed: Plugin install upload form alignment and spacing below the file input
  • Thanks: @peopleinside for helping discover and report many of these issues

1.5.3

  • Improved: Multisite and network admin experience — network dashboard, sites management, setup, upgrades, and related admin screens
  • Improved: Studio Hub theme compatibility with multisite and network admin workflows
  • Improved: Mobile dashboard layout for Welcome, Quick Actions, and workspace cards in Studio Hub
  • Fixed: Various multisite, network admin, and Studio Hub bugs and stability issues

  • Minor stability and compatibility improvements

1.5.0

  • New: Studio Hub admin theme — customizable card-based workspace home
  • New: Workspace customization tools and dashboard widgets
  • New: Admin theme settings — colors, appearance modes, and per-theme options
  • New: Workspace notes for quick reminders and todos (Studio Hub)
  • New: Activity overview widget for the workspace home
  • Improved: Dark mode support across the admin workspace, setup wizard, settings screens, and modal dialogs
  • Improved: Setup wizard appearance toggle, branding step, and onboarding flow
  • Improved: Theme settings live preview, reset, and save behavior when dark mode is active
  • Improved: Notification center experience and admin notice organization
  • Improved: WooCommerce admin compatibility when Studio Hub is active
  • Fixed: Theme settings and color controls not updating correctly in some dark mode states
  • Fixed: Minor admin icon and notification display issues
  • Various stability, accessibility, compatibility, and UI refinements

1.1.2

  • Fixed Notification Center issues and improved reliability
  • Improved compatibility with Wordfence
  • Fixed missing and incorrect admin icons
  • Fixed toast notifications display and behavior issues
  • Minor bug fixes and improvements

1.1.1

  • Improved Login Page settings experience when disabled
  • Added quick enable toggle inside Login Page tab
  • Minor UI refinements
  • Stability improvements

1.1.0

  • Added modern login page customizer
  • Added live login page preview
  • Added custom login logo and side image support
  • Added full screen login page preview
  • Improved admin interface styling
  • Performance improvements and refinements

1.0.0

  • Initial public release

Known Issues

  • In multisite environments, the Network Admin icon may not appear on some editor screens while Focus Mode is enabled. Additional compatibility improvements are planned in future updates.
